modules.name: OSC
modules.description: OSC is an oscillator: it produces a steady, unchanging tone, the raw material almost every synthesizer sound is built from

modules.name: WAVETABLE
modules.description: WAVETABLE is an oscillator that holds a sequence of 16 different waveforms, like the frames of an animation, from the brightest (a saw) to the smoothest (a sine)

modules.name: ADDITIVE
modules.description: ADDITIVE builds sound by adding up 64 sine waves, each at a different frequency

modules.name: OPERATOR
modules.description: OPERATOR is an FM synthesizer with four sine oscillators, called operators

modules.name: PULSAR
modules.description: PULSAR produces a train of tiny sound pulses, each followed by silence

modules.name: SPECTRA
modules.description: SPECTRA listens to a sound, finds its strongest frequencies, and plays them again with a set of sine oscillators

modules.name: PLL
modules.description: PLL is an oscillator that knows how to follow another

modules.name: CHORD
modules.description: CHORD turns one note into a chord

modules.name: NOISE
modules.description: NOISE produces noise, the sound of all frequencies mixed at random, in several colors at once, each on its own output: from white, hissy and bright, to brown, deep like the sea

modules.name: MATTER
modules.description: MATTER simulates an object that vibrates when struck: a string, a bell, a metal plate, a tube

modules.name: STRING
modules.description: STRING simulates a string: plucked, as on a guitar; hammered, as on a piano; or bowed, as on a violin

modules.name: DRUM
modules.description: DRUM is a ready-made percussion voice: on each pulse at the GATE input, it plays a hit

modules.name: GENDYN
modules.description: GENDYN is a sound source in which the wave is a polygon of a few points

modules.name: RUNGLER
modules.description: RUNGLER has two oscillators and an 8-bit register

modules.name: FILTER
modules.description: FILTER lets part of a sound's frequencies through and cuts the rest

modules.name: LADDER
modules.description: LADDER is the ladder filter, the bass filter: four 6 dB stages in cascade, with the output of the last one fed back to the input as resonance

modules.name: FORMANT
modules.description: FORMANT makes a sound pronounce vowels

modules.name: VOCODER
modules.description: VOCODER makes one sound speak with another's voice

modules.name: RESONATOR
modules.description: RESONATOR is a body that rings when something strikes it

modules.name: WASP
modules.description: WASP is a filter that distorts

modules.name: LPG
modules.description: LPG, short for low pass gate, is a gate that opens and closes the sound on every strike, lowering the volume and darkening the tone at the same time

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: VCA controls the volume of one sound with another signal

modules.name: VCA4
modules.description: VCA4 puts four volume controls on one panel, plus an output that adds all four

modules.name: SHAPE
modules.description: SHAPE enriches a sound by distorting it in controlled ways

modules.name: SHIFTER
modules.description: SHIFTER moves every frequency in a sound by the same number of hertz

modules.name: CRUSH
modules.description: CRUSH dirties sound the digital way

modules.name: PARAMETRIC
modules.description: PARAMETRIC is a four-band equalizer, the studio tool for adjusting a tone with precision

modules.name: GLIDE
modules.description: GLIDE makes one note slide into the next instead of jumping

modules.name: CONTROL
modules.description: CONTROL adjusts control signals before they reach their destination

modules.name: DYNAMICS
modules.description: DYNAMICS is a compressor

modules.name: ELASTIC
modules.description: ELASTIC is a chain of masses tied by springs, fixed at both ends

modules.name: TAPE
modules.description: TAPE is a tape machine

modules.name: ENVELOPE
modules.description: ENVELOPE shapes a note over time: how it starts, how it falls, how much it sustains and how it fades

modules.name: FUNCTION
modules.description: FUNCTION generates a ramp that rises and falls without stopping

modules.name: STAGES
modules.description: STAGES draws a curve made of several linked segments, from two to eight

modules.name: DRIFT
modules.description: DRIFT produces very slow movements, on the scale of minutes

modules.name: CHAOS
modules.description: CHAOS generates unpredictable movement from a simulated physical system: something like a ball rolling between two valleys, sometimes settling in one, sometimes jumping to the other

modules.name: SH
modules.description: SH, short for sample and hold, captures the value of a signal at the moment of a pulse and holds it until the next pulse

modules.name: BOUNCE
modules.description: BOUNCE drops balls that bounce, lower and faster each time, until they stop

modules.name: MOUSSE
modules.description: MOUSSE is a foam

modules.name: PENDULUM
modules.description: PENDULUM is a double pendulum: a pendulum with another hanging from its tip

modules.name: EPICYCLE
modules.description: EPICYCLE draws with circles: up to eight, each one turning on the rim of the one before

modules.name: SUPPLY
modules.description: SUPPLY is the patch's power supply, put into a module with cables

modules.name: MAGNET
modules.description: MAGNET is a grid of 8 by 8 small magnets, each pointing up or down

modules.name: ORBIT
modules.description: ORBIT is a small solar system: a sun in the centre and two or three planets in gravity

modules.name: PRESSURE
modules.description: PRESSURE is a box of gas

modules.name: REFRACT
modules.description: REFRACT is a light ray that starts inside a glass layer, crosses three others and exits into air

modules.name: PREDATOR
modules.description: PREDATOR is a small ecosystem: prey that grow on their own and predators that grow by eating

modules.name: FORM
modules.description: FORM shapes the whole piece

modules.name: CLOCK
modules.description: CLOCK is the patch's timekeeper

modules.name: LOGIC
modules.description: LOGIC combines and transforms rhythms

modules.name: TURING
modules.description: TURING invents melodies by chance and lets you keep the ones you like

modules.name: SEQUENCE
modules.description: SEQUENCE plays a short phrase you write: up to eight notes, each with its own pitch, each on or silent

modules.name: TRIGSEQ
modules.description: TRIGSEQ generates drum rhythms on four lanes at once, meant for kick, snare, hi-hat and an extra percussion

modules.name: ARP
modules.description: ARP is an arpeggiator: it plays a chord note by note, and so a chord becomes a melody

modules.name: CELL
modules.description: CELL is a cellular automaton: a row of cells, lit or unlit, that rewrites itself on every pulse

modules.name: TAP
modules.description: TAP gives the patch the tempo of whoever is playing

modules.name: POLYGON
modules.description: POLYGON is polymeter drawn as a figure

modules.name: BUDGET
modules.description: BUDGET gives the voices a budget of events

modules.name: INTERFERENCE
modules.description: INTERFERENCE is a screen lit by two or three coherent light sources

modules.name: SWARM
modules.description: SWARM is a school of six fish, and each fish is a clock with its own tempo

modules.name: ECLIPSE
modules.description: ECLIPSE is the Moon with its two months

modules.name: SEASON
modules.description: SEASON is a very slow clock: a day with sunrise and sunset, a year with four seasons

modules.name: TEMPO
modules.description: TEMPO makes the tempo breathe

modules.name: VOLTA
modules.description: VOLTA is a loop of steps that varies without getting lost

modules.name: QUANTIZER
modules.description: QUANTIZER pins a continuous signal to the notes of a scale

modules.name: HARMONY
modules.description: HARMONY decides which keys the music passes through

modules.name: ABACUS
modules.description: ABACUS treats signals as numbers

modules.name: DECISION
modules.description: DECISION is the patch's source of choices

modules.name: BOXCAR
modules.description: BOXCAR measures a signal in short windows and averages many measurements in a row

modules.name: MARKOV
modules.description: MARKOV is a Markov chain: it learns where a melody goes from where (after this note came that one three times, that other one once) and improvises by drawing the next note from what it learned

modules.name: COHERENCE
modules.description: COHERENCE measures how predictable a melody is and breaks when it becomes too ordered

modules.name: KEY
modules.description: KEY listens to whoever is playing, estimates the key and hands the tonic and scale to QUANTIZER

modules.name: ACCENT
modules.description: ACCENT gives a line its phrasing

modules.name: BLEFE
modules.description: BLEFE is a game of trust made of signals

modules.name: FRONTEIRA
modules.description: FRONTEIRA listens to a melody and marks where a new idea begins

modules.name: VERSUS
modules.description: VERSUS mixes two signals with polarity and decides when the mix crosses a threshold

modules.name: INTERPRET
modules.description: INTERPRET plays the incoming notes the way a performer would

modules.name: PHRASE
modules.description: PHRASE proposes a motif and plays it when pulses arrive at CLK

modules.name: SWITCH
modules.description: SWITCH is a selector switch operated by the patch

modules.name: MATRIX
modules.description: MATRIX connects four inputs to four outputs along every possible path at once

modules.name: MULT
modules.description: MULT takes a control signal and distributes it to four outputs, each with its own size and offset adjustment

modules.name: PLANAR
modules.description: PLANAR blends four sounds placed at the corners of a square

modules.name: VIA
modules.description: VIA is the signal's path treated as matter

modules.name: RELATE
modules.description: RELATE takes two voices and returns them transformed by the relationship between them

modules.name: SUM
modules.description: SUM joins signals

modules.name: SPACE
modules.description: SPACE puts the sound in a place

modules.name: HALL
modules.description: HALL is a stereo reverb, the sound of a large hall, a church or a studio plate

modules.name: LOOPER
modules.description: LOOPER is an echo that imitates magnetic tape

modules.name: SWIRL
modules.description: SWIRL brings together four movement effects: chorus, flanger, ensemble and phaser

modules.name: MEMORY
modules.description: MEMORY continuously records the last three seconds of whatever goes into it and plays that material back in tiny pieces, called grains

modules.name: SAMPLER
modules.description: SAMPLER records a stretch of whatever goes into it, up to about eight seconds, divides that stretch into slices, and plays them when it receives pulses

modules.name: TURNTABLE
modules.description: TURNTABLE plays a recording as if it were on a vinyl record

modules.name: SPRING
modules.description: SPRING is a spring reverb

modules.name: PRISM
modules.description: PRISM splits sound into colours, as a prism splits light

modules.name: APOCRIFO
modules.description: APOCRIFO brings the distant past into the present, as a rupture

modules.name: CUTUP
modules.description: CUTUP cuts up the patch's own sound in tempo

modules.name: LENS
modules.description: LENS is a camera lens for sound

modules.name: SCOPE
modules.description: SCOPE shows a signal's waveform, like an oscilloscope, and measures what it hears: volume, brightness, pitch and the start of each note

modules.name: LISTEN
modules.description: LISTEN follows the energy of incoming sound in three regions: low, mid and high
